question: Which festival is celebrated to commemorate the birth anniversary of Lord Buddha ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vesak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Vesak**, also known as Buddha Purnima, is celebrated to commemorate the birth, enlightenment, and death (Parinirvana) of Lord Buddha.
 
• It is observed by Buddhists across the globe, particularly in countries such as India, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Myanmar, Cambodia, and Nepal.
 
• The celebration typically falls on the full moon day of the lunar month of Vaisakha (April–May).
 
• Vesak is marked by various activities such as meditation, prayer, hoisting Buddhist flags, lighting candles, and performing acts of kindness.
 
• The day is recognized as a significant cultural and spiritual event by the United Nations since 1999.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Parinirvana Day**: This day, also known as Nirvana Day, is observed to mark the death of Lord Buddha and his attainment of final Nirvana. It is celebrated primarily by Mahayana Buddhists.
 
• **Ullambana**: This is a Buddhist festival focused on saving ancestors from suffering, celebrated primarily in East Asia and associated with the concept of filial piety.
 
• **Kathina**: A Theravada Buddhist festival held after the end of the rainy season retreat, during which robes and other necessities are offered to monks.
 
• **Buddhism**: It is a spiritual tradition founded by Siddhartha Gautama (Lord Buddha) in the 5th–4th century BCE, emphasizing the Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path to achieve liberation from suffering.
 
• **UN Recognition**: Vesak is officially recognized by the United Nations, acknowledging its importance as one of the most sacred days in Buddhism.
